reviewMethod: Independently read all 172 initially retained complete bilingual pairs and selected meanings/POS with every full frozen field, lexical evidence and variant in untruncated ranges 0+30,30+30,60+30,90+30,120+30,150+22; then read all 28 non-retained complete frozen records, covering the entire 200-entry queue without approving author-deferred records. All 200 frozen meanings/POS/variants match the actual canonical dictionary (absent variants and [] normalize to none). Evidence is published-Chinese-source-only, not WordNet or morphological equivalence. Checked actual head use, grammar/POS, source-sense/type fidelity, naturalness, translation precision, technical terminology, kinship and register individually. The initial full-read TSV is preserved byte-for-byte in qa/b-original-read-p033.tsv. After root-authorised author-only corrections, reread each of the eleven complete changed final rows and its complete frozen source: croucher, bacardi, hijra, litho, cyclop, sherif, selectee, rotorcraft, aromatherapist, camerawork and phrasebook. Re-read unchanged bentgrass with the full source after root explicitly accepted the genus-gloss plant-reference reading. Exact subset comparison independently confirms touchpaper is the only removal, the other 160 complete rows are unchanged, only the authorised eleven rows changed, and all retained terms remain in original order. Final compiled 171 entries equal the final locked TSV field-for-field and the exact current source hash is pinned. Mechanical checks establish freshness/provenance, not language judgment.
